messages:
Anya D: Quick sync 1: PLG experiment proposal: free credits + curated prompt packs + lightweight onboarding nudges. Success metric: +15% 7-day DAU among new signups. Launch next Tues. Who takes what?
Mike P: I'll lead the benchmark narrative + landing copy. Plan: short hero stat, 3 micro-benchmarks (latency p95, cost/token, dev time to integrate), and a code-first quickstart.
Sara L: I can build the onboarding flow and email sequence. Proposal: 3 credits at signup, 24h behavioral nudge, 72h tips email w/ use-case prompts. Small SMS cohort (2%) to test urgency.
Ben K: I'll own instrumentation. Need event names and UTM schema. Also will capture tokens_used and first_open_time.
Nina O: I'll do lead routing. SFDC fields: source, activation_variant, demo_requested. Where do we surface activation_variant? utm_content?
Anya D: Yes, put activation_variant in utm_content (credit-3 | credit-5 | control). Mike: include a short "how we measured" blurb in the benchmark doc.
Mike P: Draft sections: TL;DR numbers, benchmark charts + methodology, quickstart + prompt pack, CTA to webinar + signup. Will aim for a dev-centric tone.
Sara L: Draft email cadence (short):
- Day0: Welcome + credits + quickstart link
- Day1: Prompt pack + 1-click sample in app
- Day3: Success stories + webinar invite
Example snip: "Try these 2 prompts to get value in 2 minutes 7 <link>"
Sara L: Prompt template example (short):
```
{ name: "meeting_notes", prompt: "Summarize this meeting into 5 bullet points:\n{transcript}" }
```
Ben K: Analytics snippet:
```js
track('plg.signup', {variant: 'credit-3', step: 'email_sent'})
```
Nina O: Example SFDC webhook payload (demo):
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.example/lead -d '{"email":"{email}","source":"PLG","activation_variant":"credit-3"}'
```
Anya D: Webinar ops: 25-min demo + 5-min AMA. Proposed Thu 11am PT. Deploy-bot, create calendar event and zoom.
deploy-bot: Created event "PLG Kickoff: Quickstart & Benchmarks" Thu 11:00 PT 1 attendees invited.
Mike P: I'll deliver landing copy by Friday. Ben, add a dataLayer push on signup so we can attribute variants.
Ben K: Yep: dataLayer.push({ event: 'signup', activation_variant: '{{utm_content}}' }); I'll also flag a token-usage alert for spikes.
Sara L: I'll wire the in-app 1-click nudge and the email templates, will sync with Nina for SFDC field names.
Anya D: Owners: landing+benchmarks: Mike; onboarding+emails: Sara; analytics: Ben; routing: Nina; webinar: Anya. Quick check-in Mon morning to validate tracking and assets. :rocket:
